name: Vodafone Idea Limited
remarksWeb: 1. The Capital Raising Committee of the Board of Directors of the company at their meetings held on 18 July, 2024 and 19 July 2024 has allotted 1,660,810,804 equity shares at a price of Rs 14.80/- (FV Rs. 10/-) per equity share (including a premium of Rs. 4.80/- per equity share) to Nokia Solutions and Networks India Private Limited (1,027,027,024 equity shares) and Ericsson India Private Limited (633,783,780 equity shares), Non- Promoters (Vendors) of the Company, on preferential basis in terms of Chapter V of SEBI (ICDR) Regulations, 2018 in four tranches. 415202701 equity shares (256756756 shares to Nokia Solutions and Networks India Private Limited and 158445945 shares to Ericsson India Private Limited) were allotted under each Tranche. The allotment of Tranche I and Tranche II was made on 18 July 2024 and of Tranche III and Tranche IV was made on 19 July 2024. Post the aformentioned allotment, the Shareholding of Nokia Solutions and Networks India Private Limited and Ericsson India Private Limited stands to 1.47% and 0.91% respectively. 2. Our Company has allotted 16,00,00,000 Equity Shares  to Abhigam Shares and Securities Private Limited and Apex Homes Private Limited on July 12, 2024 pursuant to conversion of Optionally Convertible Debentures. The Corporate Action and Listing of these equity shares allotted were pending as on 19 July 2024.
